title: Households Taught by the Snowsports School and the Amount Carried Forward From an Equipment Rental and Demo Finding
content:
A household whose riders are being taught by the collective's own instructors is on the collective's own snow under the collective's own eye, and on an Equipment Rental and Demo finding a reduced part of what is left is carried forward.

## The rule

Where the household holds a Snowsports School booking for the season, and the school account carries at least 3 sessions delivered in the four months before the assessment is made, the school heavy share of what is left is carried forward. The school heavy share is 70 per cent.

Where the household holds a Snowsports School booking for the season and the school account carries fewer than 3 sessions delivered in those four months, the school light share is carried forward instead. The school light share is 85 per cent.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes what is carried forward.

## The conditions in combination

| Snowsports School booking held for the season | Sessions delivered on the school account in the four months before the assessment | Share of what is left carried forward |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 3 or more | 70 per cent |
| yes | 0, 1 or 2 | 85 per cent |
| no | none counted | nothing under this heading |

The count of 3 is met by 3 sessions delivered and is not met by 2. The window is the four months running back from the day the assessment is made, so sessions delivered earlier than that are not counted although the booking itself still stands.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical finding

Take a finding on Equipment Rental and Demo kit where 89.00 USD is left when this heading is reached.

- The household holds a school booking for the season and the school account shows 5 sessions delivered inside the four months: 70 per cent of 89.00 USD, that is 62.30 USD, is carried forward.
- The household holds a school booking for the season and the school account shows 1 session delivered inside the four months: 85 per cent of 89.00 USD, that is 75.65 USD, is carried forward.
- The household holds no school booking for the season: nothing under this heading changes the 89.00 USD carried forward.

## Points of judgement

**What is looked at first.** Whether a Snowsports School booking stands for the household for the season. Where none stands, the sessions are not counted at all.

**A booking with nothing delivered yet.** A booking held for the season with no session delivered inside the four months carries 0 sessions, which is fewer than 3, so the school light share of 85 per cent is what is carried forward.
